body:
#102 local implementation and acceptance progress

Started from freshly fetched main `511ff91d04983afb706eb20989be0b400e6299b9`. The clean implementation commit is `95c87d4e70d92ec31072a30df3d764d75172b7b3`; later documentation/evidence changes do not relabel the wheel source.

- Full Hyperliquid native regression: 1,244 passed, 12 existing ignored (not executed). Independent direct-executable review: 41 selected high-risk cases passed, zero ignored.
- Controlled clean source-bound Windows CPython 3.12.9 wheel built and installed into the isolated native validation environment only. Wheel SHA256: `be8d46c2d0b5f197852086b8818b4a17172aa000416512d73893c6041c129aed`. Installed normal factory/config/stub suite: 209 passed. Independent wheel review is in progress.
- Original funding/ledger/fill-fee source bytes, exact decimals, raw Unknowns and local composite identities feed one bounded exclusive checkpoint. Source preservation and report/immutable receipt consumption are separate atomic phases. Restart, weak multiplicity, changed-payload conflict, inclusive pagination, exact native commission and real filesystem failure paths are covered. Report consumption does not restore funds/readiness or apply a second fee.
- Library Clippy, nightly Rust format and relevant Ruff pass. Test-target Clippy is blocked by unchanged Windows persistence/parquet.rs documentation lints; make format/pre-commit could not launch because make is absent. These limitations and all real intermediate failures are retained, with equivalent checks stated precisely.

Only credential-free synthetic peers and non-started installed builders were used. Actual private settlements and application real entry/close remain separate E6 acceptance. Final evidence archive, independent wheel review, PR checks and merge are still pending.
